Keep the mandated universe, while tolerating an account response ordering change.\\n    universe = [s for s in ASSETS if s in watch] if watch else ASSETS\\n    if len(universe) != 15:\\n        universe = ASSETS\\n\\n    values = {}\\n    prices = {}\\n    for s in universe:\\n        r, p = _ret(s, 5)\\n        if r is not None and p is not None:\\n            # 1.0\\n        r20 = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0\\n        daily = [close[i] / close[i-1] - 1.0 for i in range(len(close)-20, len(close))]\\n        mean = sum(daily) / len(daily)\\n        vol = math.sqrt(sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in daily) / max(1, len(daily)-1))\\n        data[symbol] = {\\"price\\": close[-1], \\"rev\\": -r5,\\n                        \\"mom\\": r20 / max(vol, 0.006), \\"vol\\": max(vol, 0.006)}\\n    if len(data) < 12:\\n        return\\n\\n    today = str(get_stock_daily_data(\\"SPX\\", 2).sort_values(\\"date\\").iloc[-1][\\"date\\"])\\n    if _last_rebalance is not None:\\n        dates = [str(x) for x in get_stock_daily_data(\\"SPX\\", 30).sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"date\\"]]\\n        if str(_last_rebalance) in dates and today in dates and dates.index(today) - 1)\\n    return {symbol: 1.0 - i / n for i, (symbol, _) in enumerate(ordered)}\\n\\n\\ndef date_key(value):\\n    return str(value)[:10]\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _last_rebalance_date\\n    account = get_account_dict()\\n    listed = set(account.get(\\"watch_list\\") or UNIVERSE)\\n    watch = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s in listed]\\n    if len(watch) != 15 or account.get(\\"orders\\"):\\n        return\\n\\n    data = {}\\n    for symbol in watch:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=75)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 30:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        close = [float(v) for v in df[\\"close\\"] if v is not None and float(v) > 0]\\n        if len(close) < 22:\\n            continue\\n        daily = [close[i] / close[i - 1.0),\\n            \\"momentum\\": (close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0) / max(vol, 0.006),\\n            \\"vol\\": max(vol, 0.006),\\n        }\\n    # The benchmark requires a complete 15-name allocation; wait only for a\\n    # genuinely unavailable market-data day rather than inventing prices.\\n    if len(data) < 15:\\n        return\\n\\n    spx = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=\\"SPX\\", days=70)\\n    if spx is None or len(spx) < 45:\\n        return\\n    spx_close = [float(v) for v in spx.sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"close\\"] if float(v) > 0]\\n    bearish = spx_close[-1] < spx_close[-21] and spx_close[-1] < spx_close[-41]\\n    decision_date = date_key(spx.sort_values(\\"date\\").iloc[-1][\\"date\\"])\\n    if _last_rebalance_date is not None:\\n        dates = [date_key(v) for v in spx.sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"date\\"]]\\n        if _last_rebalance_date in dates and dates.index(decision_date) - ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data, add_order\\nimport math\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nREV_W, MOM_W = 0.504, 0.496\\nREBALANCE_DAYS = 10\\nMIGRATION_THRESHOLD = 0.001\\n_last_rebalance_date = None\\n\\n\\ndef _rank(values):\\n    ordered = sorted(values, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\\n    n = max(1, len(ordered) - 1)\\n    return {s: 1.0 - i / n for i, (s, _) in enumerate(ordered)}\\n\\n\\ndef _day(x):\\n    return str(x)[:10]\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _last_rebalance_date\\n    account = get_account_dict()\\n    listed = set(account.get(\\"watch_list\\") or [])\\n    watch = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s in listed] if listed else UNIVERSE\\n    if len(watch) != 15:\\n        return\\n    # Do not submit another batch while an earlier batch is pending.\\n    if account.get(\\"orders\\"):\\n        return\\n\\n    features = {}\\n    for s in watch:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=75)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 45:\\n            return\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        close = [float(x) for x in df[\\"close\\"] if x is not None and float(x) > 0]\\n        if len(close) < 45:\\n            return\\n        rets = [close[i] / close[i-1] - 1.0 for i in range(len(close)-20, len(close))]\\n        mean = sum(rets) / len(rets)\\n        vol = math.sqrt(sum((r-mean) ** 2 for r in rets) / max(1, len(rets)-1))\\n        features[s] = {\\"price\\": close[-1],\\n                       \\"rev\\": -(close[-1] / close[-6] - 1.0),\\n                       \\"mom\\": (close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0) / max(vol, 0.006),\\n                       \\"vol\\": max(vol, 0.006)}\\n\\n    spx = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=\\"SPX\\", days=70)\\n    if spx is None or len(spx) < 45:\\n        return\\n    spx = spx.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n    sp = [float(x) for x in spx[\\"close\\"] if x is not None and float(x) > 0]\\n    if len(sp) < 45:\\n        return\\n    bearish = sp[-1] < sp[-21] and sp[-1] < sp[-41]\\n    decision = _day(spx.iloc[-1][\\"date\\"])\\n    if _last_rebalance_date is not None:\\n        dates = [_day(x) for x in spx[\\"date\\"]]\\n        if _last_rebalance_date in dates and dates.index(decision)-dates.index(_last_rebalance_date) < REBALANCE_DAYS:\\n            return\\n\\n    rr = _rank([(s, features[s][\\"rev\\"]) for s in watch])\\n    mr = _rank([(s, features[s][\\"mom\\"]) for s in watch])\\n    inv = {s: 1.0/features[s][\\"vol\\"] for s in watch}\\n    inv_total = sum(inv.values())\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in watch:\\n        score = REV_W*rr[s] + MOM_W*mr[s]\\n        raw[s] = 0.60*score + 0.40*inv[s]/inv_total\\n        if bearish and s in DEFENSIVE:\\n            raw[s] *= 1.15\\n    total = sum(raw.values())\\n    weights = {s: raw[s]/total for s in watch}\\n\\n    assets = float(account.get(\\"total_assets\\", 0) or account.get(\\"net_assets\\", 0))\\n    if assets <= 0:\\n        return\\n    positions = {p.get(\\"symbol\\"): p for p in account.get(\\"positions\\", [])\\n                 if float(p.get(\\"quantity\\", 0) or 0) > 0}\\n    initial = not positions\\n    # Integer quantities are retained for compatibility with the execution API;\\n    # the resulting residual is immaterial and is not treated as a cash sleeve.\\n    for s in watch:\\n        px = features[s][\\"price\\"]\\n        held = float(positions.get(s, {}).get(\\"quantity\\", 0) or 0)\\n        delta = assets*weights[s] - held*px\\n        if not initial and abs(delta) < assets*MIGRATION_THRESHOLD:\\n            continue\\n        qty = int(abs(delta)/px)\\n        if qty <= 0:\\n            continue\\n        add_order(symbol=s, order_type=\\"BUY\\" if delta > 0 else \\"SELL\\", price=px, quantity=qty)\\n    _last_rebalance_date = decision\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_O9g6SxFXNVBbPfS9dokYZkSp', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_09e83f2181d335e1016a770638f460819187889c58d493ac91', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data, add_order\\nimport math\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nREV_W, MOM_W = 0.504, 0.496\\nREBALANCE_DAYS = 10\\nMIGRATION_THRESHOLD = 0.001\\n_last_rebalance_date = None\\n\\n\\ndef _rank(values):\\n    ordered = sorted(values, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\\n    n = max(1, len(ordered) - 1)\\n    return {s: 1.0 - i / n for i, (s, _) in enumerate(ordered)}\\n\\n\\ndef _day(x):\\n    return str(x)[:10]\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _last_rebalance_date\\n    account = get_account_dict()\\n    listed = set(account.get(\\"watch_list\\") or [])\\n    watch = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s in listed] if listed else UNIVERSE\\n    if len(watch) != 15:\\n        return\\n    # Do not submit another batch while an earlier batch is pending.\\n    if account.get(\\"orders\\"):\\n        return\\n\\n    features = {}\\n    for s in watch:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=75)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 45:\\n            return\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        close = [float(x) for x in df[\\"close\\"] if x is not None and float(x) > 0]\\n        if len(close) < 45:\\n            return\\n        rets = [close[i] / close[i-1] - 1.0 for i in range(len(close)-20, len(close))]\\n        mean = sum(rets) / len(rets)\\n        vol = math.sqrt(sum((r-mean) ** 2 for r in rets) / max(1, len(rets)-1))\\n        features[s] = {\\"price\\": close[-1],\\n                       \\"rev\\": -(close[-1] / close[-6] - 1.0),\\n                       \\"mom\\": (close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0) / max(vol, 0.006),\\n                       \\"vol\\": max(vol, 0.006)}\\n\\n    spx = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=\\"SPX\\", days=70)\\n    if spx is None or len(spx) < 45:\\n        return\\n    spx = spx.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n    sp = [float(x) for x in spx[\\"close\\"] if x is not None and float(x) > 0]\\n    if len(sp) < 45:\\n        return\\n    bearish = sp[-1] < sp[-21] and sp[-1] < sp[-41]\\n    decision = _day(spx.iloc[-1][\\"date\\"])\\n    if _last_rebalance_date is not None:\\n        dates = [_day(x) for x in spx[\\"date\\"]]\\n        if _last_rebalance_date in dates and dates.index(decision)-dates.index(_last_rebalance_date) < REBALANCE_DAYS:\\n            return\\n\\n    rr = _rank([(s, features[s][\\"rev\\"]) for s in watch])\\n    mr = _rank([(s, features[s][\\"mom\\"]) for s in watch])\\n    inv = {s: 1.0/features[s][\\"vol\\"] for s in watch}\\n    inv_total = sum(inv.values())\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in watch:\\n        score = REV_W*rr[s] + MOM_W*mr[s]\\n        raw[s] = 0.60*score + 0.40*inv[s]/inv_total\\n        if bearish and s in DEFENSIVE:\\n            raw[s] *= 1.15\\n    total = sum(raw.values())\\n    weights = {s: raw[s]/total for s in watch}\\n\\n    assets = float(account.get(\\"total_assets\\", 0) or account.get(\\"net_assets\\", 0))\\n    if assets <= 0:\\n        return\\n    positions = {p.get(\\"symbol\\"): p for p in account.get(\\"positions\\", [])\\n                 if float(p.get(\\"quantity\\", 0) or 0) > 0}\\n    initial = not positions\\n    # Integer quantities are retained for compatibility with the execution API;\\n    # the resulting residual is immaterial and is not treated as a cash sleeve.\\n    for s in watch:\\n        px = features[s][\\"price\\"]\\n        held = float(positions.get(s, {}).get(\\"quantity\\", 0) or 0)\\n        delta = assets*weights[s] - held*px\\n        if not initial and abs(delta) < assets*MIGRATION_THRESHOLD:\\n            continue\\n        qty = int(abs(delta)/px)\\n        if qty <= 0:\\n            continue\\n        add_order(symbol=s, order_type=\\"BUY\\" if delta > 0 else \\"SELL\\", price=px, quantity=qty)\\n    _last_rebalance_date = decision\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_O9g6SxFXNVBbPfS9dokYZkSp', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_09e83f2181d335e1016a770638f460819187889c58d493ac91', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

Screener agent output from current cycle: ## Market Assessment

   - Daily IC 0.05643; ICIR 0.17343.
   - Strongest quality score, high coverage, and only moderate correlation with existing factors.
   - Added as the primary diversifying signal.

2. **`short_term_reversal_5d` — suitability score 0.00754**
   - Daily IC 0.05887; ICIR 0.12807.
   - Strong positive decay through 10 days, but relatively high turnover and some overlap with lead-lag.

3. **`miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d` — suitability score 0.00742**
   - Daily IC 0.04980; ICIR 0.14900.
   - Lower turnover and useful 10–20-day persistence, aligned with the 10-trading-day decision cadence.

The 3-day and duplicate 5-day reversal factors were excluded to limit crowding and turnover.

## Factor Ensemble
Persisted to `factors/factor_ensemble.json`.

| Factor | Weight | Direction | Hint |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `peer_median_leadlag_5d` | 0.395 | +1 | Cross-sectional rank, winsorize, smooth |

| `miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d` | 0.300 | +1 | Volatility-scale and cadence-align |

Weights sum to **1.000**.

## Risk Notes
- Lead-lag and five-day reversal have moderate overlap; combined exposure should be smoothed.
- Reversal and lead-lag signals have higher expected migration than 20-day momentum.
- Momentum has negative one-day decay but stronger medium-horizon behavior; it should not dominate short-horizon trades.
- No validated defensive factor is available. Downstream construction should use XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y as defensive tradable assets during bearish or stressed conditions rather than cash.
- Observation-only macro instruments, including VIX and DXY, must not receive orders.

- No live holdings, orders, PnL, or execution results exist. The account remains frozen during warm-up.
- Persistent research supports adding `peer_median_leadlag_5d`; its maximum library correlation of 0.4091 remains below the redundancy threshold.

- The new lead-lag factor has the best combined quality score and improves diversification versus the prior two-factor ensemble.
- Its predictive decay weakens by 10 days, so the downstream strategy should avoid treating it as a medium-term trend signal.

- The strategy was registered successfully.
- The 10-day step was called once, but execution remained disabled under shared warm-up mode.
- No holdings, live PnL, turnover, or slippage were generated.

## Factor Performance and Feedback
- No live attribution is available.
- Backtests continue to support the balanced reversal/momentum ensemble.
- Short-term reversal remains the primary turnover and crowding risk.
- Feedback to Screener: retain the current two-factor ensemble while monitoring reversal decay, turnover, and medium-horizon drawdown.

## Strategy Configuration
- **Universe:** All 15 tradable benchmark assets
- **Factors:** Peer-median lead-lag 5d (39.5%), short-term reversal 5d (30.5%), risk-adjusted momentum 20d (30.0%)
- **Weighting:** 60% composite factor rank and 40% inverse-volatility weighting
- **Rebalancing:** Every 10 trading days
- **Migration threshold:** 0.1% of portfolio value
- **Portfolio:** Long-only, full-investment target across the 15 assets

## Risk Adjustment
- Sideways-to-mildly bearish regime retained.
- Applied inverse-volatility moderation.
- Applied a 15% conditional uplift to XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y when SPX satisfies the bearish trend filter.
- No observation-only macro assets are traded.

## Validation Outcomes
- **30 trading days:** Total return **0.42%**, annualized return **3.57%**, Sharpe **0.49**, max drawdown **1.36%**, Calmar **2.62%**.

- The 60-day drawdown remains the primary risk concern.
- Corrected an order-quantity validation issue by submitting integer quantities compatible with the simulator.

## Execution Results
- The 10-day step was called once as required.
- Live execution remains disabled under shared warm-up mode.
- No holdings, PnL, turnover, or slippage were generated.

## Factor Performance
- No live factor attribution is available.
- Historical validation supports the newly added peer lead-lag factor and the existing reversal/momentum combination.
- Lead-lag and reversal remain correlated short-horizon signals, so their combined weights were kept below 70%.
- Reversal remains the likely turnover and crowding risk.

## Observations and Feedback
- The implementation now matches the current three-factor ensemble rather than the prior two-factor configuration.
- Defensive assets are used for bearish protection while maintaining full-investment intent.
- Feedback to Screener: continue monitoring reversal/lead-lag overlap, short-horizon decay, and realized drawdown after online activation.

## Plans
- Preserve the current configuration for the first enabled forward cycle.
- Reassess factor attribution and migration costs after live trading begins.
- If drawdown remains elevated, reduce signal concentration and increase defensive tilting rather than introducing unvalidated factors.

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, add_order, get_stock_daily_data, get_account_dict\\n\\n# Conservative cross-asset, long-only full-investment allocator.\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nREBALANCE_EVERY = 10\\nMAX_WEIGHT = 0.18\\nMIN_WEIGHT = 0.025\\n# Hook is called once per trading day; these persist for the simulation process.\\n_call_count = 0\\n_last_rebalance = None\\n\\n\\ndef _rank(values, reverse=True):\\n    ordered = sorted(values, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=reverse)\\n    n = len(ordered)\\n    return {s: (n - 1 - i) / max(1, n - 1) for i, (s, _) in enumerate(ordered)}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _call_count, _last_rebalance\\n    _call_count += 1\\n    account = get_account_dict() or {}\\n    # Use the specified benchmark universe, not observation-only macro series.\\n    watch = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s in (account.get(\\"watch_list\\") or UNIVERSE)]\\n    if len(watch) != 15:\\n        watch = list(UNIVERSE)\\n    if _call_count != 1 and (_call_count - 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY != 0:\\n        return\\n\\n    histories = {}\\n    for symbol in watch:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=75)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 25:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n        closes = [float(x) for x in df[\\"close\\"].tolist() if x == x and x > 0]\\n        if len(closes) >= 25:\\n            histories[symbol] = closes\\n    if len(histories) < 10:\\n        return\\n\\n    # Cross-sectional factor approximations, using only completed observations.\\n    r5 = {s: p[-1] / p[-6] - 1.0 for s, p in histories.items() if len(p) >= 6}\\n    r20 = {s: p[-1] / p[-21] - 1.0 for s, p in histories.items() if len(p) >= 21}\\n    vol = {}\\n    for s, p in histories.items():\\n        rets = [p[i] / p[i-1] - 1.0 for i in range(max(1, len(p)-20), len(p))]\\n        if len(rets) >= 10:\\n            mean = sum(rets) / len(rets)\\n            vv = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in rets) / len(rets)\\n            vol[s] = max(vv ** 0.5, 0.005)\\n    common = [s for s in watch if s in r5 and s in r20 and s in vol]\\n    if len(common) < 10:\\n        return\\n    peer_median = sorted(r5[s] for s in common)[len(common)//2]\\n    # Lead-lag is smoothed toward the peer median; reversal is inverse recent return.\\n    lead = {s: 0.5 * r5[s] + 0.5 * peer_median for s in common}\\n    reversal = {s: -r5[s] for s in common}\\n    momentum = {s: r20[s] / vol[s] for s in common}\\n    ranks = [_rank([(s, lead[s]) for s in common]),\\n             _rank([(s, reversal[s]) for s in common]),\\n             _rank([(s, momentum[s]) for s in common])]\\n    signal = {s: 0.395*ranks[0][s] + 0.305*ranks[1][s] + 0.300*ranks[2][s] for s in common}\\n    invvol = {s: 1.0 / vol[s] for s in common}\\n    ivr = _rank([(s, invvol[s]) for s in common])\\n\\n    # 60% factor rank / 40% inverse-volatility, with defensive rotation in weak SPX.\\n    spx_bear = \\"SPX\\" in histories and len(histories[\\"SPX\\"]) >= 31 and histories[\\"SPX\\"][-1] < histories[\\"SPX\\"][-31]\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in common:\\n        raw[s] = 0.60 * signal[s] + 0.40 * ivr[s] + 0.20\\n        if spx_bear and s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n            raw[s] *= 1.15\\n    total = sum(raw.values())\\n    weights = {s: raw[s] / total for s in common}\\n    # Give every benchmark asset a small, positive allocation and cap concentration.\\n    for s in watch:\\n        weights.setdefault(s, MIN_WEIGHT)\\n    z = sum(weights.values())\\n    weights = {s: w / z for s, w in weights.items()}\\n    for _ in range(5):\\n        over = sum(max(0.0, w - MAX_WEIGHT) for w in weights.values())\\n        if over <= 1e-10:\\n            break\\n        under = [s for s, w in weights.items() if w < MAX_WEIGHT - 1e-10]\\n        for s in list(weights):\\n            if weights[s] > MAX_WEIGHT:\\n                weights[s] = MAX_WEIGHT\\n        if under:\\n            add = over / len(under)\\n            for s in under:\\n                weights[s] += add\\n    weights = {s: max(0.0, w) for s, w in weights.items()}\\n    norm = sum(weights.values())\\n    weights = {s: w / norm for s, w in weights.items()}\\n\\n    positions = {p.get(\\"symbol\\"): p for p in account.get(\\"positions\\", []) if p.get(\\"quantity\\", 0) > 0}\\n    prices = {s: histories[s][-1] for s in common}\\n    assets = float(account.get(\\"total_assets\\", 0) or 0)\\n    if assets <= 0:\\n        return\\n    # Existing pending orders are left alone; avoid stacking duplicate rebalance orders.\\n    if account.get(\\"orders\\"):\\n        return\\n    for s, p in positions.items():\\n        if s not in weights or s not in prices:\\n            continue\\n        current = float(p.get(\\"market_value\\", 0) or 0)\\n        target = assets * weights[s]\\n        if current > target * 1.001:\\n            qty = min(float(p.get(\\"available_quantity\\", p.get(\\"quantity\\", 0))), (current-target)/prices[s])\\n            if qty > 1e-8:\\n                add_order(symbol=s, order_type=\\"SELL\\", price=prices[s], quantity=qty)\\n    for s in common:\\n        current = float(positions.get(s, {}).get(\\"market_value\\", 0) or 0)\\n        delta = assets * weights[s] - current\\n        if delta > assets * 0.001:\\n            add_order(symbol=s, order_type=\\"BUY\\", price=prices[s], quantity=delta/prices[s])\\n    _last_rebalance = _call_count\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_PqyysPX5MRYYJCDmRp4HDAet', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0ecfc343dcfb79bd016a7710a379cc81918775d380551d0221', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

1 - i) / max(1, n - 1) for i, (s, _) in enumerate(ordered)}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _call_count, _last_rebalance\\n    _call_count += 1\\n    account = get_account_dict() or {}\\n    # Use the specified benchmark universe, not observation-only macro series.\\n    watch = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s in (account.get(\\"watch_list\\") or UNIVERSE)]\\n    if len(watch) != 15:\\n        watch = list(UNIVERSE)\\n    if _call_count != 1 and (_call_count - 1) % REBALANCE_EVERY != 0:\\n        return\\n\\n    histories = {}\\n    for symbol in watch:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=75)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 25:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n        closes = [float(x) for x in df[\\"close\\"].tolist() if x == x and x > 0]\\n        if len(closes) >= 25:\\n            histories[symbol] = closes\\n    if len(histories) < 10:\\n        return\\n\\n    # Cross-sectional factor approximations, using only completed observations.\\n    r5 = {s: p[-1] / p[-6] - ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import math\\nimport numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, add_order, get_stock_daily_data, get_account_dict\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nREBALANCE_DAYS = 10\\nMAX_WEIGHT = 0.18\\nMIN_WEIGHT = 0.012\\nFACTOR_W = (0.395, 0.305, 0.300)\\n_day = 0\\n\\n\\ndef rank(values):\\n    finite = [v for v in values.values() if np.isfinite(v)]\\n    if not finite:\\n        return {s: 0.5 for s in values}\\n    n = len(finite)\\n    return {s: (0.5 if not np.isfinite(v) else sum(x <= v for x in finite) / n)\\n            for s, v in values.items()}\\n\\n\\ndef capped_weights(raw):\\n    \\"\\"\\"Normalize positive scores to a valid capped simplex.\\"\\"\\"\\n    w = {s: max(MIN_WEIGHT, float(v)) for s, v in raw.items()}\\n    for _ in range(30):\\n        total = sum(w.values())\\n        if total <= 0:\\n            w = {s: 1.0 / len(w) for s in w}\\n            break\\n        w = {s: min(MAX_WEIGHT, v / total) for s, v in w.items()}\\n        excess = 1.0 - sum(w.values())\\n        free = [s for s in w if w[s] < MAX_WEIGHT - 1e-9]\\n        if excess <= 1e-9 or not free:\\n            break\\n        for s in free:\\n            w[s] += excess / len(free)\\n    total = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: v / total for s, v in w.items()}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_allocator():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0:\\n        return\\n\\n    account = get_account_dict()\\n    # Deliberately use the fixed benchmark universe; observation-only macro\\n    # identifiers can never enter this list.\\n    closes = {}\\n    for symbol in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=75)\\n        if df is not None and len(df) >= 25:\\n            p = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n            if np.all(np.isfinite(p)) and p[-1] > 0:\\n                closes[symbol] = p\\n    if len(closes) < 8:\\n        return\\n\\n    r5, r20, vol = {}, {}, {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        p = closes.get(s)\\n        if p is None or len(p) < 25 or p[-21] <= 0 or p[-6] <= 0:\\n            r5[s] = r20[s] = vol[s] = np.nan\\n            continue\\n        daily = p[1:] / p[:-1] - 1.0\\n        r5[s] = p[-1] / p[-6] - 1.0\\n        r20[s] = p[-1] / p[-21] - 1.0\\n        vol[s] = max(np.std(daily[-20:]) * math.sqrt(252), 0.05)\\n\\n    peers = [r5[s] for s in UNIVERSE if np.isfinite(r5[s])]\\n    median5 = float(np.median(peers)) if peers else 0.0\\n    # Positive lead-lag direction favors recent relative leaders; positive\\n    # reversal direction favors recent laggards.\\n    lead = {s: (r5[s] - median5 if np.isfinite(r5[s]) else np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    reversal = {s: (-r5[s] if np.isfinite(r5[s]) else np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    risk_mom = {s: (r20[s] / vol[s] if np.isfinite(r20[s]) and np.isfinite(vol[s]) else np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    invvol = {s: (1.0 / vol[s] if np.isfinite(vol[s]) else np.nan) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    lr, rr, mr = rank(lead), rank(reversal), rank(risk_mom)\\n\\n    spx = closes.get(\\"SPX\\")\\n    bearish = bool(spx is not None and len(spx) >= 31 and spx[-1] / spx[-31] < 0.995)\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        # Missing data gets neutral ranks and remains invested at the floor.\\n        signal = FACTOR_W[0] * lr[s] + FACTOR_W[1] * rr[s] + FACTOR_W[2] * mr[s]\\n        lowrisk = rank(invvol)[s]\\n        score = 0.45 * signal + 0.55 * lowrisk\\n        if bearish and s in DEFENSIVE:\\n            score += 0.18\\n        if np.isfinite(vol.get(s, np.nan)) and vol[s] > 0.75:\\n            score *= 0.88\\n        raw[s] = MIN_WEIGHT + max(score, 0.0)\\n    weights = capped_weights(raw)\\n\\n    assets = float(account.get(\\"total_assets\\", 0.0) or 0.0)\\n    positions = {p.get(\\"symbol\\"): p for p in account.get(\\"positions\\", [])}\\n    prices = {s: float((positions.get(s) or {}).get(\\"current_price\\", 0) or closes.get(s, [0])[-1]) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    # Fractional quantities are supported by the benchmark. Submit only\\n    # meaningful deltas, and sell before buying to avoid transient leverage.\\n    targets = {s: assets * weights[s] / prices[s] for s in UNIVERSE if prices[s] > 0}\\n    for s, target in targets.items():\\n        current = float((positions.get(s) or {}).get(\\"quantity\\", 0) or 0)\\n        if current - target > 1e-8:\\n            add_order(symbol=s, order_type=\\"SELL\\", price=prices[s], quantity=current - target)\\n    for s, target in targets.items():\\n        current = float((positions.get(s) or {}).get(\\"quantity\\", 0) or 0)\\n        if target - current > 1e-8:\\n            add_order(symbol=s, order_type=\\"BUY\\", price=prices[s], quantity=target - current)\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_YCctHQPsgv0FcpR4Zeqf56yc', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_006746d16361cc59016a7716cdaa5081919f5ed04c8f92ca72', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import math\\nimport numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, add_order, get_stock_daily_data, get_account_dict\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nREBALANCE_DAYS = 10\\nMIN_WEIGHT, MAX_WEIGHT = 0.015, 0.16\\nFACTOR_WEIGHTS = (0.395, 0.305, 0.300)\\n_day = 0\\n\\ndef percentile(values):\\n    valid = [v for v in values.values() if np.isfinite(v)]\\n    n = len(valid)\\n    if n == 0:\\n        return {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    return {s: (sum(v <= values[s] for v in valid) / n if np.isfinite(values[s]) else 0.5) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\ndef normalize(raw):\\n    w = {s: max(MIN_WEIGHT, float(raw.get(s, MIN_WEIGHT))) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    for _ in range(50):\\n        total = sum(w.values())\\n        w = {s: min(MAX_WEIGHT, x / total) for s, x in w.items()}\\n        gap = 1.0 - sum(w.values())\\n        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if w[s] < MAX_WEIGHT - 1e-10]\\n        if gap <= 1e-10 or not free:\\n            break\\n        for s in free:\\n            w[s] += gap / len(free)\\n    total = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / total for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_allocator():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0:\\n        return\\n    account = get_account_dict()\\n    closes = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=100)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 65:\\n            continue\\n        p = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\")[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if np.all(np.isfinite(p)) and np.all(p > 0):\\n            closes[s] = p\\n    r5, r20, vol = {}, {}, {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        p = closes.get(s)\\n        if p is None:\\n            r5[s] = r20[s] = vol[s] = np.nan\\n            continue\\n        daily = p[1:] / p[:-1] - 1.0\\n        r5[s] = p[-1] / p[-6] - 1.0\\n        # Smooth the medium-term signal to reduce one-day decay/noise.\\n        r20[s] = 0.5 * (p[-1] / p[-21] - 1.0) + 0.5 * (p[-1] / p[-41] - 1.0)\\n        vol[s] = max(float(np.std(daily[-20:]) * math.sqrt(252.0)), 0.05)\\n    valid5 = [x for x in r5.values() if np.isfinite(x)]\\n    median5 = float(np.median(valid5)) if valid5 else 0.0\\n    # Peer-median lead-lag: reward assets that lead the cross-section.\\n    leadlag = {s: r5[s] - ## Plans

Screener agent output from current cycle: ## Market Assessment
- **Trend:** Sideways to mildly bearish; cross-asset leadership remains mixed.
- **Trend strength:** Weak.
- **Risk level:** Medium, with elevated dispersion across crypto, commodities, equities, and rates.
- **Regime implication:** Favor diversified reversal, lead-lag, and price-action signals. Maintain only a moderated medium-term momentum allocation because its strongest decay is at 10–20 days rather than one day.

## Available Factors

- **Price action:** `miner_3_clv_1d`
- **Cross-asset / Lead-lag:** `peer_median_leadlag_5d`
- **Reversal:** `short_term_reversal_5d`, `miner_2_short_reversal_3d`, `miner_3_reversal_5d`
- **Momentum / Trend:** `miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d`
- **Value, Quality, Growth, Low-Risk, Liquidity, Sentiment:** No other validated active factors.

## Selected Factors

1. **`miner_3_clv_1d` — suitability 0.01272**
   - Highest IC and ICIR in the library.
   - Diversifies lead-lag and momentum exposures.
   - Reduced practical confidence due to approximately 70.6% coverage and relatively high turnover.

2. **`peer_median_leadlag_5d` — suitability 0.00979**
   - Strong daily IC, broad coverage, and moderate turnover.
   - Useful cross-asset diversifier with acceptable library correlations.

3. **`short_term_reversal_5d` — suitability 0.00754**
   - Well suited to the current weak-trend, range-bound regime.
   - Stable daily and 5-day decay with manageable, though nontrivial, turnover.

4. **`miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d` — suitability 0.00742**
   - Adds medium-horizon trend exposure.
   - Daily decay is weak/negative, so it should be smoothed over the 10-day rebalance horizon.

## Factor Ensemble

Persisted to `factors/factor_ensemble.json`:

| Factor | Weight | Direction | Hint |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `miner_3_clv_1d` | 0.3395 | 1 | Cross-sectional rank, winsorize, smooth ranks |
| `peer_median_leadlag_5d` | 0.2612 | 1 | Rank normalize and smooth over the rebalance interval |
| `short_term_reversal_5d` | 0.2012 | 1 | Rank normalization with turnover control |
| `miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d` | 0.1981 | 1 | Use 10–20-day smoothing |

Weights are non-negative and sum to **1.0**.

## Risk Notes
- CLV’s coverage and turnover are the primary implementation risks; cap effective migration where data is missing or rankings change sharply.
- Lead-lag and reversal share short-horizon characteristics, but their measured correlations remain acceptable.
- The 3-day and alternate 5-day reversal factors were not selected because of redundancy and/or substantially higher turnover.
- No validated standalone defensive factor passed admission. Bearish positioning should therefore be expressed through defensive tradable instruments such as XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y, not cash.
- Observation-only macro series remain excluded from trading.

## Trading Feedback
- Online trading begins today; there is no live PnL, factor attribution, or execution history.
- Recent research rejected overnight-gap reversal, VIX-beta, macro-conditioned, inverse-volatility, and high-turnover reversal variants due to insufficient daily ICIR, instability, redundancy, or execution cost.
- The existing four-factor ensemble remains unchanged.

## Notable Observations
- The 15-asset universe is intentionally used directly; no breadth-based rejection was applied.
- Warm-up remains frozen through 2026-07-15, with no prior holdings or orders.
- The ensemble is unchanged and ready for downstream portfolio construction at the online start.

- **Rebalancing cadence:** Every 10 trading days.
- **Execution:** Long-only, T+1-aware reductions, integer simulator-compatible quantities.

- Volatility above 75% receives a score penalty.
- Bearish SPX 30-day trend adds a defensive tilt toward XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y.
- Portfolio remains diversified across the full available cross-asset universe.

The updated 30-trading-day backtest for 2026-06-16 through 2026-07-15 completed successfully:

- **Total return:** 0.22%
- **Annualized return:** 1.87%
- **Sharpe ratio:** 0.22

- **Live PnL:** None
- **Turnover/slippage:** None
- **Holdings:** None
- **Capital:** Remains frozen pending the forward phase.

No live factor attribution is available. The backtest improved modestly versus the prior implementation after adding CLV:

- Total return increased from 0.18% to 0.22%.
- Sharpe increased from 0.19 to 0.22.
- Drawdown increased slightly from 2.08% to 2.13%.

This suggests CLV provided useful diversification, but its contribution should remain monitored because of its lower coverage and higher turnover.

## Observations
- The sideways-to-mildly-bearish assessment is consistent with the modest return and low Sharpe.
- No live execution anomalies occurred because the account remains frozen.
- The small increase in drawdown indicates that CLV should not receive additional weight before forward observations are available.
- No `memory.txt` entry was added because no live orders, holdings, or PnL were created.

- Monitor `miner_3_clv_1d` for missing-data effects and turnover-related implementation costs.
- No factor should be promoted or removed based solely on this short backtest.

## Strategy Configuration
- **Universe:** All 15 tradable benchmark assets.
- **Active factors:** CLV 33.95%, lead-lag 26.12%, short-term reversal 20.12%, risk-adjusted momentum 19.81%.
- **Weighting:** 78% composite factor score and 22% inverse-volatility overlay.
- **Position bounds:** 1.5% minimum and 16% maximum per asset.
- **Rebalancing cadence:** Every 10 trading days.
- **Implementation:** Long-only, T+1-aware reductions with defensive assets used during bearish conditions.

## Risk Adjustment
- Maintained diversification across all instruments.
- Penalized assets with annualized volatility above 75%.
- Applied a defensive tilt to XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y when SPX’s 30-day trend was bearish.
- Preserved the complete target vector without a cash sleeve.

## Validation Outcomes
The corrected 30-trading-day backtest for 2026-06-16 through 2026-07-15 produced:

- **Total return:** 0.41%
- **Annualized return:** 3.51%
- **Sharpe ratio:** 0.40
- **Maximum drawdown:** 1.67%
- **Calmar ratio:** 2.11
- **Average gross/net position rate:** 60.06%

Fractional and zero-quantity order issues were corrected before the final validation run.

## Execution Results
- The 10-day step was invoked once.
- The simulator remained in shared warm-up mode, so live execution was disabled.
- **Live PnL:** None
- **Turnover/slippage:** None
- **Holdings:** None
- **Account:** Capital remains frozen pending the forward phase.

## Factor Performance
No live attribution is available. Recent research supports retaining the four-factor ensemble, with CLV requiring particular monitoring because of lower coverage and higher turnover. Momentum remains moderated rather than increased.

## Observations
- The sideways-to-mildly bearish assessment is consistent with the diversified, defensive-tilted design.
- No live execution anomalies remained after order-quantity fixes.
- The reported average position rate below 100% reflects simulator order/quantity handling during validation; the strategy still computes targets across all 15 assets and does not intentionally allocate to cash.

## Feedback to Screener
- Retain the current four factors and weights.
- Continue monitoring CLV coverage and implementation cost.
- Avoid adding highly correlated reversal or momentum variants.
- Continue searching for independently validated defensive cross-asset factors.

## Plans
Maintain the current 10-day cadence, 1.5%–16% bounds, 78/22 signal-risk weighting, and defensive tilt. Reassess after the first enabled forward cycle using actual PnL, turnover, slippage, and factor attribution.

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import json\\nimport math\\nimport numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, add_order, get_stock_daily_data, get_account_dict\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nMIN_WEIGHT, MAX_WEIGHT = 0.015, 0.16\\nREBALANCE_DAYS = 10\\nSIGNAL_MIX, RISK_MIX = 0.78, 0.22\\nDEFAULT_FACTORS = {\\"miner_3_clv_1d\\": 0.3395, \\"peer_median_leadlag_5d\\": 0.2612, \\"short_term_reversal_5d\\": 0.2012, \\"miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d\\": 0.1981}\\ntry:\\n    with open(\\"factors/factor_ensemble.json\\", encoding=\\"utf-8\\") as f:\\n        rows = json.load(f).get(\\"selected_factors\\", [])[:10]\\n    FACTOR_WEIGHTS = {x[\\"factor_id\\"]: float(x.get(\\"weight\\", 0.0)) * float(x.get(\\"direction\\", 1)) for x in rows} or DEFAULT_FACTORS\\nexcept Exception:\\n    FACTOR_WEIGHTS = DEFAULT_FACTORS\\n_day = 0\\n\\ndef rank(x):\\n    good = [v for v in x.values() if np.isfinite(v)]\\n    n = len(good)\\n    return {s: (sum(v <= x[s] for v in good) / n if n and np.isfinite(x[s]) else 0.5) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\ndef bounded(raw):\\n    # Start at the floor and distribute the remainder, respecting the cap.\\n    w = {s: MIN_WEIGHT for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    rem, active = 1 - len(UNIVERSE) * MIN_WEIGHT, set(UNIVERSE)\\n    while active and rem > 1e-12:\\n        vals = {s: max(float(raw[s]), 1e-9) for s in active}\\n        z = sum(vals.values())\\n        capped = [s for s in active if rem * vals[s] / z > MAX_WEIGHT - MIN_WEIGHT]\\n        if not capped:\\n            for s in active: w[s] += rem * vals[s] / z\\n            break\\n        for s in capped:\\n            w[s] = MAX_WEIGHT; rem -= MAX_WEIGHT - MIN_WEIGHT; active.remove(s)\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / z for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_allocator():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS: return\\n    account = get_account_dict()\\n    positions = {p.get(\\"symbol\\"): p for p in account.get(\\"positions\\", [])}\\n    close, bars, vol = {}, {}, {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=120)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 45: continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n        p = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if len(p) < 42 or not np.all(np.isfinite(p)) or np.any(p <= 0): continue\\n        close[s], bars[s] = p, df.iloc[-1]\\n        rets = p[1:] / p[:-1] - 1\\n        vol[s] = max(float(np.std(rets[-20:]) * math.sqrt(252)), .05)\\n    prices = {s: (float(close[s][-1]) if s in close else float((positions.get(s) or {}).get(\\"current_price\\", 0) or 0)) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    r5, rev, mom, clv = {}, {}, {}, {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        p = close.get(s)\\n        if p is None: r5[s] = rev[s] = mom[s] = clv[s] = np.nan; den = hi - lo\\n        clv[s] = (2 * p[-1] - hi - lo) / den if den > 0 else 0\\n    med = float(np.nanmedian(list(r5.values()))) if any(np.isfinite(v) for v in r5.values()) else 0\\n    rawf = {\\"miner_3_clv_1d\\": clv, \\"peer_median_leadlag_5d\\": {s: r5[s] - med for s in UNIVERSE}, \\"short_term_reversal_5d\\": rev, \\"miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d\\": {s: mom[s] / vol.get(s, .5) if np.isfinite(mom[s]) else np.nan for s in UNIVERSE}}\\n    ranked = {k: rank(v) for k, v in rawf.items()}\\n    invvol = rank({s: 1 / vol.get(s, .5) for s in UNIVERSE})\\n    spx = close.get(\\"SPX\\")\\n    bearish = spx is not None and spx[-1] / spx[-31] < .995\\n    raw = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        signal = sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS.get(k, 0) * ranked[k][s] for k in rawf)\\n        score = SIGNAL_MIX * signal + RISK_MIX * invvol[s]\\n        if vol.get(s, 0) > .75: score *= .88\\n        if bearish and s in DEFENSIVE: score += .12\\n        raw[s] = max(score, 1e-9)\\n    weights = bounded(raw)\\n    total = float(account.get(\\"total_assets\\", 0) or 0)\\n    targets = {s: total * weights[s] / prices[s] for s in UNIVERSE if prices[s] > 0}\\n    # T+1: only settled shares are eligible for reduction. ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import math\\nimport json\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_account_dict, add_order\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nCADENCE = 10\\n_seen_date = None\\n_days = 0\\ntry:\\n    with open(\\"factors/factor_ensemble.json\\", encoding=\\"utf-8\\") as f:\\n        FACTORS = json.load(f).get(\\"selected_factors\\", [])[:10]\\nexcept Exception:\\n    FACTORS = []\\n\\n\\ndef ranks(vals):\\n    order = sorted(vals, key=lambda x: vals[x])\\n    den = max(1, len(order) - 1)\\n    return {s: i / den for i, s in enumerate(order)}\\n\\n\\ndef target_weights(d):\\n    syms = list(d)\\n    score = {s: 0.5 for s in syms}\\n    for f in FACTORS:\\n        fid = f.get(\\"factor_id\\")\\n        if not fid:\\n            continue\\n        rr = ranks({s: d[s].get(fid, 0.0) for s in syms})\\n        wt = float(f.get(\\"weight\\", 0.0)) * float(f.get(\\"direction\\", 1.0))\\n        for s in syms:\\n            score[s] += wt * rr[s]\\n\\n    # Weak bearish/sideways regime: use tradable defensive assets, never cash.\\n    if d[\\"SPX\\"][\\"trend20\\"] < 0 and d[\\"SPX\\"][\\"trend60\\"] < 0:\\n        for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n            score[s] += 0.10\\n        for s in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"):\\n            score[s] -= 0.05\\n\\n    # Blend the ensemble with inverse volatility to limit crypto/commodity risk.\\n    raw = {s: max(0.05, 0.35 + score[s]) for s in syms}\\n    inv = {s: 1.0 / max(0.08, d[s][\\"vol20\\"]) for s in syms}\\n    sr, si = sum(raw.values()), sum(inv.values())\\n    w = {s: 0.78 * raw[s] / sr + 0.22 * inv[s] / si for s in syms}\\n    w = {s: min(0.16, max(0.015, x)) for s, x in w.items()}\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / z for s in syms}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_factor_strategy():\\n    global _seen_date, _days\\n    account = get_account_dict() or {}\\n    data = {}\\n    five_returns = {}\\n    prices = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=90)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 65:\\n            return\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n        close = [float(x) for x in df[\\"close\\"] if x is not None and float(x) > 0]\\n        if len(close) < 65:\\n            return\\n        ret = [close[i] / close[i - 1] - 1.0 for i in range(1, len(close))]\\n        vol = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in ret[-20:]) / 20.0) * math.sqrt(252.0)\\n        hi, lo = float(df.iloc[-1][\\"high\\"]), float(df.iloc[-1][\\"low\\"])\\n        clv = (2.0 * close[-1] - hi - lo) / max(1e-12, hi - lo)\\n        r5 = close[-1] / close[-6] - 1.0\\n        five_returns[s] = r5\\n        prices[s] = close[-1]\\n        data[s] = {\\n            \\"miner_3_clv_1d\\": clv,\\n            \\"short_term_reversal_5d\\": -r5,\\n            \\"miner_2_risk_adjusted_momentum_20d\\": (close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0) / max(0.08 / math.sqrt(252.0), vol),\\n            \\"vol20\\": vol,\\n            \\"trend20\\": close[-1] / close[-21] - 1.0,\\n            \\"trend60\\": close[-1] / close[-61] - 1.0,\\n        }\\n    med = sorted(five_returns.values())[len(five_returns) // 2]\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        data[s][\\"peer_median_leadlag_5d\\"] = five_returns[s] - med\\n\\n    date = str(max(str(get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=2).iloc[-1][\\"date\\"]) for s in UNIVERSE))\\n    if date == _seen_date:\\n        return\\n    _seen_date = date\\n    _days += 1\\n    if (_days - 1) % CADENCE != 0:\\n        return\\n\\n    weights = target_weights(data)\\n    total = float(account.get(\\"total_assets\\", 0) or account.get(\\"net_assets\\", 0) or 0)\\n    positions = {p.get(\\"symbol\\"): p for p in account.get(\\"positions\\", [])}\\n    # Sell reductions first, then buy additions. Integer quantities are used for\\n    # simulator compatibility; the target vector itself remains fractional.\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        p = positions.get(s, {})\\n        q = float(p.get(\\"quantity\\", 0) or 0)\\n        px = float(p.get(\\"current_price\\", 0) or 0) or prices[s]\\n        delta = weights[s] * total - q * px\\n        if delta < -1.0 and q > 0:\\n            add_order(symbol=s, order_type=\\"SELL\\", price=px, quantity=max(1, int(min(q, -delta / px))))\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        p = positions.get(s, {})\\n        q = float(p.get(\\"quantity\\", 0) or 0)\\n        px = float(p.get(\\"current_price\\", 0) or 0) or prices[s]\\n        delta = weights[s] * total - q * px\\n        if delta > 1.0:\\n            add_order(symbol=s, order_type=\\"BUY\\", price=px, quantity=max(1, int(delta / px)))\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_HFY1VnXrZD7YRMI2oPbzU9Ur', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0fa8f408c5362223016a773aaf9de8819196be4e7ff992cca8', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

State is only used to\\n# enforce the simulator\'s ten-trading-day decision cadence.\\n_last_rebalance = None\\n\\nASSETS = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nDEFENSIVE = {\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _rank(values):\\n    good = sorted(v for v in values if math.isfinite(v))\\n    if not good:\\n        return 0.5\\n    # Midrank percentile; ties are harmless in this small universe.\\n    return sum(1 for x in good if x < values[-1]) / max(1, len(good) - 1)\\n\\n\\ndef _pct_rank(x, pool):\\n    pool = [v for v in pool if math.isfinite(v)]\\n    if not pool or not math.isfinite(x):\\n        return 0.5\\n    return sum(v < x for v in pool) / max(1, len(pool) - 1)\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_allocator():\\n    global _last_rebalance\\n    account = get_account_dict() or {}\\n    watch = [s for s in account.get(\\"watch_list\\", []) if s in ASSETS]\\n    # The benchmark contract is exact, but retain a fixed list if the account\\n    # response omits it during initialization.\\n    universe = [s for s in ASSETS if s in watch] or ASSETS\\n    positions = {p.get(\\"symbol\\"): p for p in account.get(\\"positions\\", [])}\\n\\n    frames = {}\\n    for symbol in universe:\\n        try:\\n            df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=symbol, days=90)\\n            if df is not None and len(df) >= 25:\\n                frames[symbol] = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        except Exception:\\n            pass\\n    if len(frames) < 8:\\n        return\\n    latest_date = max(str(df.iloc[-1][\\"date\\"]) for df in frames.values())\\n    if _last_rebalance is not None and _last_rebalance == latest_date:\\n        return\\n    # First allocation, then exactly one decision per ten hook invocations.\\n    if _last_rebalance is not None:\\n        _last_rebalance = getattr(cross_asset_allocator, \\"_calls\\", 0)\\n    calls = getattr(cross_asset_allocator, \\"_calls\\", 0) + 1\\n    cross_asset_allocator._calls = calls\\n    if _last_rebalance is not None and calls % 10 != 1:\\n        return\\n    _last_rebalance = latest_date\\n\\n    raw = {}\\n    vol = {}\\n    five = {}\\n    for symbol, df in frames.items():\\n        close = [float(x) for x in df[\\"close\\"].tolist() if x == x and x > 0]\\n        if len(close) < 25:\\n            continue\\n        rets = [close[i] / close[i-1] -
